senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Frightful Presence
traits.description: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 ft. of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Fire Breath
traits.description: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Detect
traits.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

traits.name: Tail Attack
traits.description: The dragon makes a tail attack.

traits.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
traits.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

multiattack_text: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

attacks.name: Tail
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
